claims.text: 定位为 JVM 上构建 LLM 应用的惯用开源 Java 库，非 Python LangChain 的移植。
统一 API 支持 20+ LLM 提供商与 30+ 向量存储，可切换而不改代码。
工具箱含提示模板、聊天记忆、函数调用、Agent 与 RAG，并提供 Spring Boot/Quarkus/Helidon/Micronaut 示例。

统一 API 覆盖 20+ LLM 提供商与 30+ 向量库，基于 Java 类型安全、注解、接口、DI、流式 API。

要求 JDK 17+，依赖 spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework 1.1.2.0 与 starter-dashscope 1.1.2.1。

11: 
12: 
13: ## Introduction
14: 
15: Welcome!
16: 
17: The goal of LangChain4j is to simplify integrating LLMs into Java applications.
18: 
19: Here's how:
20: 1. **Unified APIs:**
21:    LLM providers (like OpenAI or Google Vertex AI) and embedding (vector) stores (such as Pinecone or Milvus)
22:    use proprietary APIs. LangChain4j offers a unified API to avoid the need for learning and implementing specific APIs for each of them.
23:    To experiment with different LLMs or embedding stores, you can easily switch between them without the need to rewrite your code.
24:    LangChain4j currently supports [20+ popular LLM providers](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/language-models/)
25:    and [30+ embedding stores](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/embedding-stores/).
26: 2. **Comprehensive Toolbox:**
27:    Since early 2023, the community has been building numerous LLM-powered applications,
28:    identifying common abstractions, patterns, and techniques. LangChain4j has refined these into practical code.
29:    Our toolbox includes tools ranging from low-level prompt templating, chat memory management, and function calling
30:    to high-level patterns like Agents and RAG.
31:    For each abstraction, we provide an interface along with multiple ready-to-use implementations based on common techniques.
32:    Whether you're building a chatbot or developing a RAG with a complete pipeline from data ingestion to retrieval,
33:    LangChain4j offers a wide variety of options.
34: 3. **Numerous Examples:**
35:    These [examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) showcase how to begin creating various LLM-powered applications,
36:    providing inspiration and enabling you to start building quickly.
37: 
38: LangChain4j began development in early 2023 amid the ChatGPT hype.
39: We noticed a lack of Java counterparts to the numerous Python and JavaScript LLM libraries and frameworks,
40: and we had to fix that!
41: 
42: **Despite the name, LangChain4j is not a Java port of LangChain (Python) — it is built for Java, not ported to it.**
43: It is an idiomatic Java library designed from the ground up around Java conventions:
44: type safety, POJOs, annotations, interfaces, dependency injection, fluent APIs, and first-class integrations with Quarkus, Spring Boot, Helidon, and Micronaut.
45: Its API, internals, and release cycle are independent of the Python LangChain project.
46: 
47: We actively monitor community developments, aiming to quickly incorporate new techniques and integrations,
48: ensuring you stay up-to-date.
49: The library is under active development. While some features are still being worked on,
50: the core functionality is in place, allowing you to start building LLM-powered apps now!
51: 
52: 
53: ## Documentation
54: Documentation can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev).
55: 
56: The documentation chatbot (experimental) can be found [here](https://chat.langchain4j.dev/).
57: 
58: 
59: ## Getting Started
60: Getting started guide can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/get-started).
61: 
62: 
63: ## Code Examples
64: Please see examples of how LangChain4j can be used in [langchain4j-examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) repo:
65: - [Examples in plain Java](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/other-examples/src/main/java)
66: - [Examples with Quarkus](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j/tree/main/samples) (uses [quarkus-langchain4j](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j) dependency)
67: - [Example with Spring Boot](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/spring-boot-example/src/main/java/dev/langchain4j/example)
68: - [Examples with Helidon](https://github.com/helidon-io/helidon-examples/tree/helidon-4.x/examples/integrations/langchain4j) (uses [io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j](https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j) dependency)
69: - [Examples with Micronaut](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-langchain4j/tree/0.3.x/doc-examples/example-openai-java) (uses [micronaut-langchain4j](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-langchain4j/latest/guide/) dependency)
70: 
71: ## Useful Materials
72: Useful materials can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/useful-materials).
73: 
74: 
75: ## Get Help
76: Please use [Discord](https://discord.gg/JzTFvyjG6R) or [GitHub discussions](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/discussions)
77: to get help.
78: 
79: 
80: ## Request Features
81: Please let us know what features you need by [opening an issue](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/issues/new/choose).
82: 
83: 
84: ## Contribute
85: Contribution guidelines can be found [here](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

1: # [Spring AI Alibaba](https://java2ai.com) 2: 3: [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202-4EB1BA.svg)](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html) 4: [![CI Status](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) 5: [![Ask DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg)](https://deepwiki.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba) 6: [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/badge/Maven%20Central-v1.1.2.2-blue)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.alibaba.cloud.ai/spring-ai-alibaba/1.1.2.2) 7: [![gitleaks badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/protected%20by-gitleaks-blue)](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks) 8: 9: 10:

11: A production-ready framework for building Agentic, Workflow, and Multi-agent applications. 12:

13:

14: Agent Framework Docs, 15: Graph Docs, 16: Spring AI, 17: Examples. 18:

19: 20: 21: ## Architecture 22: 23:

24: 25:

26: 27: **Spring AI Alibaba Admin** is a one-stop Agent platform that supports visualized Agent development, observability, evaluation, and MCP management, etc. It also integrates with open-source low-code platforms like Dify, enabling rapid migration from DSL to Spring AI Alibaba project. 28: 29: **Spring AI Alibaba Agent Framework** is an agent development framework that can quickly develop agents with built-in **Context Engineering** and **Human In The Loop** support. For scenarios requiring more complex process control, Agent Framework offers built-in workflows like `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, `LoopAgent`. 30: 31: **Spring AI Alibaba Graph** serves as the underlying runtime of the Agent Framework, providing essential capabilities such as persistence, workflow orchestration, and streaming required for long-running stateful agents. Compared to the Agent Framework, users can build more flexible multi-agent workflows based on the Graph API. 32: 33: ## Core Features 34: 35: * **[Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multiagent-patterns)**: Compose multiple agents with built-in patterns including `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, and `LoopAgent` for complex task execution. 36: 37: * **[Multimodal Support](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multimodal)**: ReactAgent with text and media input (image understanding). ReactAgent with tool based image or audio generation. 38: 39: * **[Voice Agent](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/voice-agent)**: WebSocket-based real-time voice agent that supports streaming audio or text input and responds with generated audio. 40: 41: * **[Context Engineering](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/tutorials/hooks)**: Built-in best practices for context engineering policies to improve agent reliability and performance, including human-in-the-loop, context compaction, context editing, model & tool call limit, tool retry, planning, dynamic tool selection. 42: 43: * **[Graph-based Workflow](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/graph-core/quick-start)**: Graph based workflow runtime and api for conditional routing, nested graphs, parallel execution, and state management. Export workflows to PlantUML and Mermaid formats. 44: 45: * **[A2A Support](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/advanced/a2a)**: Agent-to-Agent communication support with Nacos integration, enabling distributed agent coordination and collaboration across services. 46: 47: * **[Rich Model, Tool and MCP Support](https://java2ai.com/integration/chatmodels/dashScope)**: Leveraging core concepts of Spring AI, supports multiple LLM providers (DashScope, OpenAI, etc.), tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 48: 49: * **[One-stop Agent Platform](https://java2ai.com/ecosystem/admin/quick-start)**: Build agent in a visualized way, deploy agent without code or export as a standalone java project. 50: 51:

52: 53:

54: 55: ## Getting Started 56: 57: ### Prerequisites 58: 59: * Requires JDK 17+. 60: * Choose your LLM provider and get the API-KEY. 61: 62: ### Quickly Run a ChatBot 63: 64: There's a ChatBot example provided by the community at [examples/chatbot](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/chatbot). 65: 66: 1. Download the code. 67: 68: ```shell 69: git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba.git 70: cd spring-ai-alibaba 71: ``` 72: 73: 2. Start the ChatBot. 74: 75: Before starting, set API-KEY first (visit Aliyun Bailian to get API-KEY): 76: ```shell 77: # this example uses 'spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope', visit https://java2ai.com to learn how to use OpenAI/DeepSeek. 78: export AI_DASHSCOPE_API_KEY=your-api-key 79: ``` 80: 81: ```shell 82: # Maven installation is optional when using mvnw. 83: ./mvnw -pl examples/chatbot spring-boot:run 84: ``` 85: 86: 3. Chat with ChatBot. 87: 88: Open the browser and visit [http://localhost:8080/chatui/index.html](http://localhost:8080/chatui/index.html) to chat with the ChatBot. 89: 90:

91: 92:

93: 94: ## Chatbot Code Explained 95: 96: 1. Add dependencies 97: 98: ```xml 99: 100: 101: com.alibaba.cloud.ai 102: spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework 103: 1.1.2.0 104: 105: 106: 107: com.alibaba.cloud.ai 108: spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope 109: 1.1.2.1 110: 111: 112: ``` 113: 114: 2. Define Chatbot 115: 116: For more details of how to write a Chatbot, please check the [Quick Start](https://java2ai.com/docs/quick-start) on our official website. 117: 118: ## 📚 Documentation 119: * [Overview](https://java2ai.com/docs/overview) - High level overview of the framework 120: * [Quick Start](https://java2ai.com/docs/quick-start) - Get started with a simple agent
